report.question: Did the defect actually exist before the fix, at the parent commit of the fix? Check out that parent in a scratch worktree and run the failing test there. A defect that does not reproduce at its own pre-fix commit means either the fix commit is misattributed or the test is measuring something else; both are discrepancies to file.
